items.title: Hackers target 178 major websites with crypto-stealing code
items.summary:
Scott Melker breaks down reports of malicious cryptocurrency-stealing code discovered across 178 major websites, including those associated with HSBC (HSBC), Salesforce (CRM), Zoom (ZM), and Ledger.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Salesforce starts fresh round of job cuts, Business Insider reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has begun another round of workforce reductions, according to internal employee communications reviewed by Business Insider, adding to the software company's restructuring activity this year as it faces mounting investor scrutiny over the impact of AI on traditional software businesses.

items.title: What Salesforce Investors Missed Before The Fall
items.summary: If headlines around Salesforce in 2026 sounded upbeat, the financials added fuel. Revenue and net income in Q2 2027 both rose compared with the prior year, and net margin stepped up sharply. Holding Salesforce from the start of the year would have meant a 22.8% loss, including dividends. If you had seen only the profit progress and AI contract wins, what early signals, if any, hinted that shareholders might still end up in the red?
